tooltips.webhookUrl: Register this URL in cal.com → Settings → Webhooks. Each integration has its own URL — the path segment is this record's id.
tooltips.signingSecret: Cal.com webhook secret. If set, the X-Cal-Signature-256 header is required and verified (HMAC-SHA256 of the body). Strongly recommended in production.
tooltips.createContactIfMissing: When enabled, creates a new Contact if the attendee email isn't found. Otherwise the webhook is skipped.

messages.webhookUrlPendingSave: Save the record to generate the webhook URL.
